title: Rising US Income Inequality and Declining Residential Electricity Consumption: Is There a Link?
abstract: After growing steadily for decades, average U.S. household energy consumption began declining in the mid-2000s. Using household-level data from the Residential Energy Consumption Survey and Current Population Survey between 1990 and 2020, we decompose overall changes in per household consumption into three components: average income, cross-household income distribution, and consumption habits, which include energy efficiency. Growth of average income caused consumption to increase by 11%, and rising income inequality reduced consumption by 8%, nearly entirely offsetting the effect of income growth. Changes in habits also reduced consumption. Back-of-the-envelope calculations indicate an unexpected effect of rising income inequality: climate and air quality improvements valued at $9 billion in 2020 due to lower electricity consumption. The results indicate the importance of coordinating policies that address inequality and pollution.
abstract_zh: 在数十年稳步增长之后，美国家庭平均能源消费自2000年代中期开始下降。利用1990至2020年间住宅能源消费调查（RECS）和当前人口调查（CPS）的住户层面数据，我们将每户消费的总体变化分解为三个组成部分：平均收入、家庭间收入分配，以及消费习惯（包括能源效率）。平均收入的增长使消费增加了11%，而收入不平等的加剧使消费减少了8%，几乎完全抵消了收入增长的效应。消费习惯的变化同样减少了消费。粗略估算表明，收入不平等加剧还产生了一个意想不到的效应：由于电力消费减少，2020年价值90亿美元的气候与空气质量改善。研究结果表明，协调解决不平等与污染问题的政策十分重要。

title: Targeted Regulation for Reducing High-Ozone Events
Vehicle Attribute Tradeoffs and the Distributional Effects of US Fuel Economy and Greenhouse Gas Emissions Standards
abstract: This paper presents welfare and distributional effects of US passenger vehicle fuel economy and greenhouse gas standards between 2012 and 2022. We build an equilibrium model that allows for endogenous markups, market shares, and nonprice attributes. The model includes fixed and variable costs of raising fuel economy, manufacturer substitution between fuel economy and performance, and heterogeneous consumer preferences and manufacturer costs. We estimate all demand and supply parameters from observed consumer and manufacturer choices. We find that the standards have increased social welfare and that consumer undervaluation of fuel cost savings accounts for most of the social benefits. Manufacturers achieve most fuel economy improvements by trading off horsepower rather than adjusting prices or adding fuel-saving technology. Due to this compliance strategy, the standards have been progressive because high-income households value horsepower much more than low-income households do. Consumer undervaluation of fuel cost savings also contributes to progressivity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2012年至2022年间美国乘用车燃油经济性与温室气体排放标准的福利及分配效应。我们构建了一个均衡模型，允许内生的加成定价、市场份额和非价格属性。该模型包括提高燃油经济性的固定成本与可变成本、制造商在燃油经济性与性能之间的替代，以及消费者偏好和制造商成本的异质性。我们利用观测到的消费者和制造商选择，估计了所有需求与供给参数。我们发现，这些标准提高了社会福利，而消费者对燃油成本节约的低估是社会收益的主要来源。制造商实现的大部分燃油经济性改善，是通过牺牲马力而非调整价格或增加节油技术实现的。由于这种合规策略，这些标准具有累进性，因为高收入家庭对马力的重视程度远高于低收入家庭。消费者对燃油成本节约的低估也促成了其累进性。

title: Building Subway Systems and Improving Air Quality in China: Evidence from Multiple Chinese Cities
The Effect of Income on Vehicle Demand: Evidence from China’s New Vehicle Market
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, vol. 11 (2024)
abstract: As incomes continue rising, vehicle ownership is expected to grow dramatically in China and other emerging countries. For these countries, little causal evidence exists on the effect of income on vehicle ownership. Using city-level data on new car registrations and income in China from 2005 to 2017 and using export-led growth to isolate plausibly exogenous income variation, we estimate an elasticity of new car sales to income of about 2.5. Recent projections of vehicle sales in China have understated actual sales by 36%. To meet its climate objectives, China will need more aggressive policies than previous forecasts indicate.
abstract_zh: 随着收入持续增长，预计中国及其他新兴经济体的汽车保有量将大幅增加。对于这些国家，关于收入对汽车保有量影响的因果证据十分匮乏。利用2005年至2017年中国城市层面的新车注册量和收入数据，并以出口导向型增长作为分离出合理外生收入变异的工具，我们估计新车销量对收入的弹性约为2.5。以往对中国汽车销量的预测低估了实际销量的36%。为实现其气候目标，中国将需要比以往预测所显示的更为积极的政策。

title: Interactions Between Federal Passenger Vehicle Standards and Zero Emission Vehicle Programs
Coal Demand, Market Forces, and US Coal Mine Closures
abstract: Economic transitions have the potential to displace workers and cause social unrest. Coal mine closures in the eastern United States due to the changing electricity system and the resulting employment losses in rural areas have become salient issues for all levels of government. Previous research has not distinguished among the potential causes of recent mine closures, such as rising production costs and decreasing coal demand from the electricity sector. This analysis utilizes unique data on coal mine and power plant operation to estimate the impact of supply and demand factors on mine closure. We model closure as a function of expected profits, which allows us to compare the effects on mine closure of specific demand and supply shocks to expected mine profits. Our results suggest that each shock substantially affected coal mine employment. Increasing costs of producing Appalachian coal have had the largest impact on closures with lower natural gas prices and lower electricity demand each accounting for a substantial number of closures additionally.
abstract_zh: 经济转型有可能导致工人失业并引发社会动荡。近年来，美国东部地区因电力系统变化而关闭的煤矿，以及由此造成的农村地区就业损失，已成为各级政府日益关注的突出问题。以往研究未能区分近期煤矿关闭的潜在原因，例如生产成本上升和电力部门煤炭需求下降。本分析利用独特的煤矿与发电厂运营数据，估计了供给与需求因素对煤矿关闭的影响。我们将矿山关闭建模为预期利润的函数，从而能够比较特定的需求与供给冲击通过预期矿山利润对矿山关闭产生的影响。我们的结果表明，各项冲击都对煤矿就业产生了显著影响。阿巴拉契亚煤炭生产成本的上升对矿山关闭的影响最大，而天然气价格走低和电力需求下降也各自导致了相当数量的额外关闭。

title: Environmental Regulation and Product Attributes: The Case of European Passenger Vehicle Greenhouse Gas Emissions Standards
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists, 10 (2023)
abstract: Energy efficiency and carbon dioxide emissions standards apply to many consumer durables, such as refrigerators and passenger vehicles. Welfare analysis of these standards is complicated by the fact that product manufacturers choose a wide range of product attributes, many of which are unobserved by the researcher. Whereas the literature has considered the effects of standards on product prices, energy efficiency, and perhaps one or two other attributes, we show that in a differentiated product market, standards can affect virtually any product attribute, and those effects have ambiguous implications for consumer welfare. This paper implements a novel strategy to estimate the causal welfare effects of standards on product attributes. Considering European carbon dioxide emissions standards for passenger vehicles, we find that these standards have reduced fuel consumption and emissions. However, the standards have unintentionally reduced vehicle quality, which undermines 26% of the welfare gains of the standards.
abstract_zh: 能效和二氧化碳排放标准适用于许多耐用消费品，如冰箱和乘用车。对这些标准的福利分析较为复杂，因为产品制造商会选择种类繁多的产品属性，其中许多属性研究者无法直接观测。尽管已有文献考察了标准对产品价格、能效以及一两项其他属性的影响，但我们表明，在产品差异化市场中，标准可以影响几乎任何产品属性，而这些影响对消费者福利的含义并不确定。本文提出了一种新颖的策略，用以估计标准对产品属性产生的因果福利效应。以欧洲乘用车二氧化碳排放标准为研究对象，我们发现这些标准降低了燃油消耗和排放。然而，这些标准无意中降低了车辆质量，从而抵消了标准所带来福利收益的26%。

title: How Much Do Consumers Value Fuel Economy and Performance? Evidence from Technology Adoption
abstract: During historical periods in which U.S. fuel economy standards were unchanging, automakers increased performance but not fuel economy, contrasting with recent periods of tightening standards and rising fuel economy. This paper evaluates the welfare consequences of automakers forgoing performance increases to raise fuel economy as standards have tightened since 2012. Using a unique data set and a novel approach to account for fuel economy and performance endogeneity, we find undervaluation of fuel cost savings and high valuation of performance. Welfare costs of forgone performance approximately equal expected fuel savings benefits, suggesting approximately zero net private consumer benefit from tightened standards.
abstract_zh: 在美国燃油经济性标准保持不变的历史时期，汽车制造商提高了车辆性能，但并未提高燃油经济性；与此形成对比的是，2012年以来标准趋严、燃油经济性随之提高的时期。本文评估了自2012年标准趋严以来，汽车制造商放弃性能提升、转而提高燃油经济性所带来的福利后果。利用一个独特的数据集，并采用一种新颖的方法来处理燃油经济性与性能之间的内生性，我们发现消费者低估了燃油成本节约，同时高估了性能。放弃性能的福利损失大致等于预期的燃油节约收益，这表明标准趋严带来的私人消费者净收益近似为零。

title: The Welfare Cost of Beijing’s Lottery Policy—Evidence from a Contingent Valuation Survey
Is There a Trade-Off Between Equity and Effectiveness for Electric Vehicle Subsidies?
How Does State-Level Carbon Pricing in the United States Affect Industrial Competitiveness?
abstract: Pricing carbon emissions from a jurisdiction could harm the competitiveness of local firms, causing the leakage of emissions and economic activity to other regions. Past research concentrated on national carbon prices, but the impacts of subnational carbon prices could be more severe due to the openness of regional economies. Focusing on subnational carbon pricing in the United States, we specify a flexible model to capture competition between a plant in a state with carbon pricing and plants in other states or countries. We estimate model parameters using confidential plant-level data from 1982-2011 and simulate the effects of regional carbon prices covering the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic (regions that currently cap carbon emissions from the electric sector) on manufacturing output, employment, and profits. Importantly, we model industry mix within a state or region, not simply energy price differences.A carbon price of $10 per metric ton reduces employment in the regulated region by 2.7 percent, and raises employment in nearby states by 0.8 percent; the effects on output and profits are broadly similar. National employment falls just 0.1 percent, suggesting that domestic plants in other states as opposed to foreign facilities are the principal winners from state or regional carbon pricing.
abstract_zh: 对某一辖区的碳排放定价可能损害当地企业的竞争力，导致排放和经济活动向其他地区泄漏。以往研究主要关注全国性碳价，但由于区域经济的开放性，次国家层面碳价的影响可能更为严重。本文聚焦于美国的次国家层面碳定价，构建了一个灵活的模型，以刻画实施碳定价的州内工厂与其他州或国外工厂之间的竞争。我们利用1982年至2011年的机密工厂层面数据估计模型参数，并模拟了覆盖东北部和中大西洋地区（目前这两个地区对电力部门碳排放实行总量控制）的区域碳价对制造业产出、就业和利润的影响。重要的是，我们对州或地区内的产业构成进行了建模，而不仅仅是考虑能源价格差异。每吨10美元的碳价会使受管制地区的就业减少2.7%，并使邻近州的就业增加0.8%；对产出和利润的影响大体相似。全国范围内的就业仅下降0.1%，这表明，在州或地区碳定价中，主要受益者是其他州的国内工厂，而非国外设施。

title: Explaining the Evolution of Passenger Vehicle Miles Traveled in the United States
abstract: After growing steadily for several decades, passenger vehicle miles traveled (VMT) in the United States unexpectedly leveled off in the 2000s. The growth rate of VMT has since rebounded, and determining the factors that explain these developments has implications for future US oil consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. We show that changes in the demographic and economic characteristics of households in the United States, rather than changes in driving habits, explain most of the recent dynamics. These results suggest that over the next decade, VMT in the United States will continue to grow roughly at historical rates, causing substantially higher oil consumption and greenhouse gas emissions than if persistent changes in household driving habits explained the recent changes in VMT.
abstract_zh: 美国乘用车行驶里程（VMT）在经历数十年的稳定增长后，于21世纪00年代意外趋于平稳。此后其增长率又重新反弹，而厘清这些变化背后的驱动因素，对未来美国的石油消费和温室气体排放具有重要意义。我们发现，驱动近期变化的主要因素是美国家庭人口统计和经济特征的变化，而非驾驶习惯的改变。这些结果表明，在未来十年，美国的VMT将大致以历史水平继续增长，由此带来的石油消费和温室气体排放将显著高于假设家庭驾驶习惯的持续性改变能够解释近期VMT变化的情形。

title: Interactions between Climate and Local Air Pollution Policies: The Case of European Passenger Cars
venue: Journal of the Association for Environmental and Resource Economists, vol. 6 (2019): 709-40
abstract: Many European countries have adopted carbon dioxide–based (CO2-based) vehicle taxes to help reduce transportation sector emissions. The literature has shown that these policies reduce CO2 emissions but has not considered whether they affect emissions that harm local air quality. This paper analyzes whether CO2-based taxes have an unintended consequence of raising emissions of nitrogen oxides (NOx) and particulates, which harm local air quality. Using highly detailed data on European new vehicle registrations from 2002 through 2010, I estimate the effects of fuel costs and vehicle taxes on consumer vehicle choices. The CO2-based vehicle taxes reduce CO2 emissions but increase NOx and particulates emissions. The environmental harms from the NOx and particulates emissions roughly offset the benefits of the lower CO2 emissions. Because of the estimated substitution patterns, fuel-based CO2 taxes introduce milder trade-offs than do vehicle taxes.
abstract_zh: 许多欧洲国家已采用基于二氧化碳（CO2）的车辆税，以帮助减少交通运输部门的排放。文献表明，这些政策确实降低了CO2排放，但尚未考虑它们是否会影响危害当地空气质量的排放。本文分析了基于CO2的税收是否会产生一种非预期后果，即增加危害当地空气质量的氮氧化物（NOx）和颗粒物排放。利用2002年至2010年欧洲新车注册的高度详细数据，我估计了燃油成本和车辆税对消费者车辆选择的影响。基于CO2的车辆税降低了CO2排放，但增加了NOx和颗粒物排放。NOx和颗粒物排放所造成的环境危害，大致抵消了CO2减排带来的收益。由于估计得到的替代模式，基于燃油的CO2税所带来的权衡比车辆税更为温和。

title: The Impacts of Lower Natural Gas Prices on Jobs in the US Manufacturing Sector
abstract: The recovery of the U.S. manufacturing sector following the 2008-2009 economic recession coincided with a sharp drop in natural gas prices. To determine whether a causal connection in fact exists, we use confidential plant-level data for 1972-2012 to estimate the employment effects of changes in natural gas and other energy prices. Previous analyses have used aggregated data and failed to control for multiple drivers of employment dynamics, such as other input costs. We show that controlling for these factors substantially diminishes the effects of natural gas and electricity prices on manufacturing employment. Accounting for the direct effects of natural gas prices as well as the indirect effects via electricity prices, we estimate that the decline in natural gas prices between 2007 and 2012 raised overall manufacturing employment by 0.6 percent, and for gas-intensive industries, by 1.8 percent.
abstract_zh: 2008–2009年经济衰退之后美国制造业的复苏，恰逢天然气价格的急剧下跌。为确定两者之间是否确实存在因果联系，我们使用了1972–2012年工厂层面的保密数据，以估计天然气及其他能源价格变动对就业的影响。以往的分析使用了加总数据，且未能控制就业动态的多种驱动因素，例如其他投入成本。我们表明，控制这些因素后，天然气和电力价格对制造业就业的影响大幅减弱。在同时考虑天然气价格的直接效应以及通过电价产生的间接效应后，我们估计，2007至2012年间天然气价格的下跌使制造业整体就业增加了0.6%，而对于天然气密集型行业，则增加了1.8%。

title: The Role of State Policies under Federal Light-Duty Vehicle Greenhouse Gas Emissions Standards
The Roles of Energy Markets and Environmental Regulation in Reducing Coal-Fired Plant Profits and Electricity Sector Emissions
Flawed Analyses of U.S. Auto Fuel Economy Standards
How Do Low Gas Prices Affect Costs and Benefits of US New Vehicle Fuel Economy Standards
venue: Economics of Energy and Environmental Policy, vol. 7 (2018)
abstract: In their initial benefit-cost analysis of the 2012-2016 passenger vehicle fuel economy standards, the U.S. regulatory agencies estimated that the benefits of the standards would be three times greater than the costs. However, their analysis was based on the high gasoline prices forecasted at the time; after their analysis, expected gasoline prices fell by 25 percent. We augment the agencies' benefit-cost framework and use recent evidence on behavioral responses to gasoline prices to estimate the effects of low gasoline prices on benefits and costs. Accounting for consumer changes in miles traveled and vehicle choice, we find that the 25 percent reduction in future gasoline prices reduces the value of fuel savings by 22 percent. Because of consumer changes in vehicle choice, lower gasoline prices raise compliance costs by about $0.5 billion per year, or about 9 percent of the total net benefits of the program. Accounting for these responses does not overturn the agencies' initial conclusions that benefits exceed costs.
abstract_zh: 在对2012至2016年乘用车燃油经济性标准进行的最初成本收益分析中，美国监管机构估计，这些标准带来的收益将是成本的三倍。然而，该分析基于当时预测的高汽油价格；在分析完成之后，预期汽油价格下降了25%。我们对监管机构的成本收益框架进行了扩展，并利用关于消费者对汽油价格行为反应的最新证据，估计了低汽油价格对收益和成本的影响。在考虑消费者行驶里程和车辆选择的变化后，我们发现未来汽油价格下降25%，使燃油节约的价值降低了22%。由于消费者车辆选择发生变化，较低的汽油价格使合规成本每年增加约5亿美元，约占该项目净收益总额的9%。将这些反应纳入考虑后，并不会推翻监管机构最初关于收益超过成本的结论。

title: The Long-Run Effects of Housing Location on Travel Behavior: Evidence from China’s Housing Reform
Vehicle Ownership Restrictions and Fertility in Beijing
Fuel Prices, New Vehicle Fuel Economy, and Implications for Attribute-Based Standards
venue: Journal of the Association for Environmental and Resource Economists, vol. 4 (2017): 659-700
abstract: Energy efficiency standards based on product attributes may interact with market conditions and affect the overall stringency of the standards. In this paper we analyze the interaction between gasoline prices and the redesigned and tightened federal fuel economy standards. Tighter standards will tend to reduce the effect of gasoline prices on market shares. Furthermore, under the standards a vehicle’s fuel economy requirement depends on its size. Lower gasoline prices incentivize consumers to purchase new vehicles with lower fuel economy, which are typically larger and therefore face lower fuel economy requirements. Using monthly data from 1996 to 2015, we find that fuel prices have had a smaller effect on market shares in recent years than previously. This result appears to be driven by a stronger response to rising than falling or stable prices. We construct two proxies for the stringency of the standards and we find limited evidence that the standards affect the relationship between fuel prices and market shares. Using the estimated responsiveness to fuel costs from the 2008 to 2015 period, the estimates imply that the 25 percent gasoline price decrease between 2014 and 2015 had a modest effect on average fuel economy and the average fuel economy required by the standards.
abstract_zh: 基于产品属性的能效标准可能与市场条件相互作用，并影响标准的整体严格程度。本文分析了汽油价格与经重新设计并加严的联邦燃油经济性标准之间的相互作用。标准越严格，汽油价格对市场份额的影响往往越小。此外，在该标准下，车辆的燃油经济性要求取决于其尺寸。汽油价格走低会激励消费者购买燃油经济性较低的新车，而这类车通常尺寸更大，因此面临的燃油经济性要求也更低。利用1996年至2015年的月度数据，我们发现，近年来燃油价格对市场份额的影响比以往更小。这一结果似乎是由消费者对价格上涨的反应强于对价格下跌或价格稳定时的反应所驱动的。我们构建了两个衡量标准严格程度的代理变量，发现仅有有限的证据表明标准会影响燃油价格与市场份额之间的关系。利用2008年至2015年期间对燃油成本的估计敏感度，我们的估计表明，2014年至2015年间汽油价格下降25%，对平均燃油经济性以及标准所要求的平均燃油经济性仅产生了有限的影响。

title: Technological Change, Vehicle Characteristics and the Opportunity Costs of Fuel Economy Standards
The Rebound Effect for Passenger Vehicles
abstract: The United States and many other countries are dramatically tightening fuel economy standards for passenger vehicles. Higher fuel economy reduces per-mile driving costs and may increase miles traveled, known as the rebound effect. The magnitude of the elasticity of miles traveled to fuel economy is an important parameter in welfare analysis of fuel economy standards, but all previous estimates impose at least one of three behavioral assumptions: (a) fuel economy is uncorrelated with other vehicle attributes; (b) fuel economy is uncorrelated with attributes of other vehicles owned by the household; and (c) the effect of gasoline prices on vehicle miles traveled is inversely proportional to the effect of fuel economy. Relaxing these assumptions yields a large effect; a one percent fuel economy increase raises driving 0.2 to 0.4 percent.
abstract_zh: 美国和许多其他国家正在大幅加严乘用车燃油经济性标准。更高的燃油经济性降低了每英里的驾驶成本，可能会增加行驶里程，即所谓的反弹效应。行驶里程相对于燃油经济性的弹性大小，是燃油经济性标准福利分析中的一个重要参数，但以往所有估计都至少依赖于以下三个行为假设之一：（a）燃油经济性与其他车辆属性不相关；（b）燃油经济性与家庭所拥有的其他车辆的属性不相关；（c）汽油价格对车辆行驶里程的影响与燃油经济性的影响成反比。放宽这些假设后，我们得到了一个较大的效应：燃油经济性提高1%，驾驶里程将增加0.2%至0.4%。

title: Who Will Be Affected by a Congestion Pricing Scheme in Beijing?
Estimating the Job Impacts of Environmental Regulation
abstract: In the face of strong policy interest in the possible regulation–jobs linkage and weak analytical evidence to support a generalizable conclusion, what should a regulatory agency like the Environmental Protection Agency do in a regulatory impact analysis (RIA)? Initially, an RIA should start with a clear concept of what the regulatory agency is trying to estimate. Much of the popular debate is looking for a total job effect. Yet one thing we do know is that, in aggregate, there will not be a net job change unless the economy deviates from its normal rate of full employment. The gist of our literature review suggests that looking to historic data for stable statistical relationships between regulatory spending and job changes, even in a single industry, is tenuous at best. However, the intuition is relatively easy to trace out with certain assumptions: (1) added costs imply added activity that entails added jobs; (2) higher product prices or other regulatory limits imply less production that entails fewer jobs. Taking an average employment rate per dollar of relevant economic activity, coupled with an assumed demand elasticity, these effects can be multiplied out into job changes, although such simple calculations must be tested by validating key assumptions or exploring the estimates sensitivity to alternatives. New estimates by Belova, Gray, Linn and Morgenstern [(2013a).Environmental Regulation And Industry Employment: A Reassessment. Center for Economic Studies, U.S. Census Bureau Discussion Paper, CES 1336, July.] indicate that extending and expanding the widely cited approach by Morgenstern, Pizer and Shih [(2002). Jobs Versus the Environment: An Industry-Level Perspective. Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 43, 412–436] is unlikely to be successful. Finally, more effort is needed to inform the public about the potential job impacts of new regulations, especially the distinction of these impacts from long-term technological and economic trends.
abstract_zh: 面对政策界对监管与就业之间可能联系的强烈关注，而分析证据又不足以支持普遍性结论，美国环境保护署等监管机构在监管影响分析（RIA）中应当如何处理？首先，RIA应当明确监管机构试图估计的对象。大量的公众辩论关注的是总体就业效应。然而，我们确实知道，在总量层面，除非经济偏离其正常的充分就业水平，否则就业净变化不会发生。我们的文献综述要点表明，寻找监管支出与就业变化之间稳定的统计关系，即便只局限于单一行业，也是站不住脚的。然而，在某些假设条件下，其背后的逻辑相对容易梳理：（1）增加的成本意味着增加的经济活动，从而带来更多就业；（2）更高的产品价格或其他监管限制意味着产量下降，从而减少就业。取单位相关经济活动的平均就业率，再结合一个假定的需求弹性，这些效应便可以乘算为就业变化，但此类简单计算必须通过检验关键假设或考察估计结果对替代假设的敏感性来加以验证。Belova、Gray、Linn和Morgenstern [（2013a）. Environmental Regulation And Industry Employment: A Reassessment. Center for Economic Studies, U.S. Census Bureau Discussion Paper, CES 1336, July.] 的最新估计表明，将 Morgenstern、Pizer 和 Shih [（2002）. Jobs Versus the Environment: An Industry-Level Perspective. Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, 43, 412–436] 这一被广泛引用的方法加以推广和扩展，不太可能取得成功。最后，还需要付出更多努力，向公众普及新监管可能带来的就业影响，尤其要将这些影响与长期技术和经济趋势区分开来。

title: Using Vehicle Taxes to Reduce Carbon Dioxide Emissions Rates of New Passenger Vehicles: Evidence from France, Germany, and Sweden
venue: American Economic Journal: Economic Policy, vol. 7, (2015): 212-42
abstract: France, Germany, and Sweden link taxes to passenger vehicles' carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions rates. Based on new vehicle registration data from 2005 to 2010, we find that CO2 taxes reduce registrations. The effect is larger in France than in either Germany or Sweden, and the French results are robust to alternative estimation models. Compared with those of France, the German results vary somewhat more, and the Swedish estimates are the least robust. We find some evidence that the French tax affected the mix of new vehicles that vehicle manufacturers offered in the French market. (JEL H23, L62, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 法国、德国和瑞典将税收与乘用车的二氧化碳（CO2）排放率挂钩。基于2005年至2010年的新车注册数据，我们发现CO2税降低了车辆注册量。这一效应在法国比在德国或瑞典更大，且法国的结果在采用其他估计模型时依然稳健。与法国相比，德国的结果变化稍大，而瑞典的估计结果稳健性最差。我们发现一些证据表明，法国的税收影响了汽车制造商在法国市场所提供的新车组合。（JEL H23, L62, Q54, Q58）

title: Gasoline Taxes and Consumer Behavior
venue: American Economic Journal: Economic Policy, vol. 6 (2014): 302-42
abstract: Gasoline taxes can be employed to correct externalities from automobile use and to raise government revenue. Our understanding of the optimal gasoline tax and the efficacy of existing taxes is largely based on empirical analysis of consumer responses to gasoline price changes. In this paper, we examine directly how gasoline taxes affect gasoline consumption as distinct from tax-inclusive retail gasoline prices. We find robust evidence that consumers respond more strongly to gasoline tax changes under a variety of model specifications. We discuss two potential reasons for our main findings as well as their implications. (JEL D12, H21, H25, H31, L71, Q35)
abstract_zh: 汽油税既可用于矫正汽车使用所产生的外部性，也可用于增加政府收入。我们对最优汽油税以及现行税收效力的理解，很大程度上基于对消费者对汽油价格变动反应的实证分析。在本文中，我们直接考察汽油税如何影响汽油消费，并将其与含税零售汽油价格的影响区分开来。我们发现，在多种模型设定下，消费者对汽油税变动的反应都更为强烈，这一结论稳健。我们讨论了导致主要发现的两种可能原因，以及它们的含义。（JEL D12, H21, H25, H31, L71, Q35）

title: The Effect of Voluntary Brownfields Programs on Nearby Property Values: Evidence from Illinois
New Vehicle Characteristics and the Cost of the Corporate Average Fuel Economy Standard
abstract: Recent legislation has increased the Corporate Average Fuel Economy (CAFE) standard by 40 percent, which represents the first major increase in the standard since its creation in 1975. Previous analysis of the CAFE standard has focused on the short run effects, in which vehicle characteristics are held fixed, or the long run, when firms can adopt new power train technology. This paper focuses on the medium run, when firms can choose characteristics such as weight and power, and have a limited ability to adopt engine technology. We first document the historical importance of the medium run and then estimate consumers' willingness-to-pay for fuel efficiency, power and weight. We employ a unique empirical strategy that accounts for the characteristics' endogeneity, which has not been addressed in the literature, by using variation in the set of engine models used in vehicle models. The results imply that an increase in power has an equal effect on vehicle sales as a proportional increase in fuel efficiency. We then simulate the medium run effects of an increase in the CAFE standard. The policy reduces producer and consumer welfare and causes substantial transfers across firms, but the effects are significantly smaller than in previous studies.
abstract_zh: 近期立法将企业平均燃油经济性（CAFE）标准提高了40%，这是该标准自1975年设立以来的首次重大提高。以往对CAFE标准的分析主要关注两种情形：一是短期效应，即车辆特征保持不变；二是长期效应，即企业可以采用新的动力总成技术。本文关注中期情形，即企业可以选择重量和动力等车辆特征，并且只有有限的能力采用发动机技术。我们首先记录了中期情形的历史重要性，然后估计了消费者对燃油效率、动力和重量的支付意愿。我们采用了一种独特的实证策略，利用车型所使用的发动机型号集合的变异来处理车辆特征的内生性问题，而这一问题在文献中尚未得到处理。结果表明，动力的提升对车辆销量的影响，与燃油效率等比例提升的影响相当。随后，我们模拟了CAFE标准提高的中期效应。该政策降低了生产者和消费者的福利，并导致企业之间产生大量转移，但其效应明显小于以往研究的结论。

title: The Price of Gasoline and New Vehicle Fuel Economy: Evidence from Monthly Sales Data
venue: American Economic Journal: Economic Policy vol. 2 (2010): 134-53
abstract: This paper uses a unique dataset of monthly new vehicle sales by detailed model from 1978 to 2007, and implements a new identification strategy to estimate the effect of the price of gasoline on individual vehicle model sales. We control for unobserved vehicle and consumer characteristics by using within model year changes in the price of gasoline and sales. We find a significant sales response, suggesting that the gasoline price increase from 2002 to 2007 explains nearly half of the decline in market share of US manufacturers. On the other hand, an increase in the gasoline tax would only modestly raise average fuel economy. (JEL H25, L11, L62, L71)
abstract_zh: 本文利用1978年至2007年按详细车型划分的月度新车销售数据，并采用一种新的识别策略，估计汽油价格对各车型销量的影响。我们利用同一车型年内汽油价格与销量的变化，控制不可观测的车辆和消费者特征。我们发现销量对汽油价格有显著反应，表明2002年至2007年间汽油价格的上涨解释了美国本土汽车制造商市场份额下降的近一半。另一方面，提高汽油税只会小幅提高平均燃油经济性。（JEL H25, L11, L62, L71）

Energy Prices and the Adoption of Energy-Saving Technology
abstract: This article investigates the link between factor prices, technology and factor demands. Using plant-level data from the Census of Manufactures, I compare the energy intensity of entrants and incumbents from 1967-97. A 10% increase in the price of energy reduces the relative energy intensity of entrants by 1%. The estimate implies that technology adoption by incumbents explains a statistically significant but relatively small fraction of changes in aggregate energy demand in the 1970s and 1980s. Furthermore, entrants' technology adoption can reduce the long run effect of energy prices on growth, but by less than previous research has found. Copyright © The Author(s). Journal compilation © Royal Economic Society 2008.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了要素价格、技术与要素需求之间的联系。利用制造业普查的工厂层面数据，我比较了1967年至1997年间新进入者与既有企业的能源强度。能源价格每上涨10%，新进入者的相对能源强度降低1%。该估计表明，既有企业的技术采用在解释20世纪70年代和80年代总能源需求变化方面具有统计显著性，但所占比例相对较小。此外，新进入者的技术采用可以降低能源价格对长期增长的影响，但降幅小于以往研究的发现。版权所有 © 作者；期刊编纂 © 英国皇家经济学会 2008。
